title: eryngium pandanifolium var. chamissonis
intro: Eryngium pandanifolium var. chamissonis, commonly known as the Seaside Blazing Star, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in South Korea, for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Eryngium pandanifolium var. chamissonis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it a potential treatment for infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
